# Nobel Prize in Physiology/Medicine 2023: A New Way of Looking at Vaccines
The first COVID-19 vaccine brought to market was based on the use of messenger RNA (mRNA) to induce an immune response to a pathogen, a different approach to developing vaccines, as opposed to using weakened or inactivated viruses, or viral vectors.
It took many years to overcome the technical obstacles to enable mRNA vaccines to work, and for these efforts, the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2023 was awarded to Katalin Karikó and Drew Weissman.

# Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2023
On Monday, 2 October 2023, the Nobel Assembly at Karolinska Institutet awarded the 2023 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine to Katalin Karikó and Drew Weissman “for their discoveries concerning nucleoside base modifications that enabled the development of effective mRNA vaccines against COVID-19”.

answer: The 2023 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded to Katalin Karikó and Drew Weissman [4]. The prize recognized their discoveries concerning nucleoside base modifications that enabled the development of effective mRNA vaccines against COVID-19 [4]. These discoveries were critical for developing effective mRNA vaccines during the pandemic that began in early 2020 [4]. The prize also recognized their breakthrough discoveries to use modified RNA for therapeutic treatments [2].
